digest.component_or_area: retrigger gate / code review block resolution
propositions: recheck-review refuses all current-revision findings, but bugfix-size-attestation blocks can be legitimately cleared by earning a plan-review attestation without code changes, creating unnecessary churn pressure
retrigger must accept recheck-review when the sole blocking finding is bugfix-size-attestation and the ticket's plan-review attestation is in an accepted bucket (certified, stale-code, stale-head)
retrigger must read eligibility only from the bot's own vote message and ticket store, never from the requesting comment, and must parse the header count to confirm exactly one blocking finding
retrigger must reject blocks where bugfix-size-attestation coexists with other blocking findings, or where the attestation is absent, stale-material, invalid, or in error state
retrigger must use the gate's own classify_plan_review_attestation and bucket_for_verdict functions to avoid drift between gate and retrigger acceptance criteria
